purpose: Detect an introduced check-then-write race after moving the uniqueness check out of the lock.

mutations.old:
with self.lock:
            if item_id in self.claimed:
                return False
            self.claimed.add(item_id)
            return True
mutations.new:
if item_id in self.claimed:
            return False
        with self.lock:
            self.claimed.add(item_id)
        return True

expected.focus: Two callers may both pass the unlocked membership check, then each return accepted for the same item. The lock protects only the set mutation, not the check-and-claim contract.
